facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on May 29, 2024 that it was named to the 2024 Best Workplaces in Mental Wellness list by Great Place to Work.
facts.quote: proud to announce that our organization has been named on the 2024 Best Workplaces in Mental Wellness

facts.fact: To be eligible for the Great Place to Work 2024 Best Workplaces in Mental Wellness list, an organization must be Great Place to Work-Certified and have exceptionally high employee scores on the Trust Index survey.
facts.quote: organizations must be Great Place to Work- Certified™ and have exceptionally high scores from employees on the Trust Index survey

facts.fact: The Great Place to Work list is based on direct feedback from employees of hundreds of organizations surveyed by Great Place to Work.
facts.quote: The list is based on direct feedback from employees of the hundreds of organizations that were surveyed by Great Place to Work®.

facts.fact: Great Place to Work states that in Canada it represents the voices of 500,000 employees across industry (a vendor-stated figure about the awarding firm, not independently verified).
facts.quote: represents the voices of 500,000 employees across industry

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world

facts.fact: StackAdapt co-founder and CEO Vitaly Pecherskiy was named to Canada's Top 40 Under 40, as announced in a blog post dated September 16, 2026.
facts.quote: StackAdapt co-founder and CEO Vitaly Pecherskiy named to Canada’s Top 40 Under 40®
